name: Big O Notation
description: Asymptotic analysis of upper bounds on algorithm runtime and memory growth.

name: Time Complexity
description: Counting basic execution operations as a function of input size N.

name: Space Complexity
description: Auxiliary memory usage analysis including stack frames and allocated heap memory.

name: Array Traversal
description: Sequential iteration, element access by index, and boundary checking.

name: Prefix Sum
description: Preprocessing cumulative sums for O(1) range sum queries.

name: Two Pointers
description: Iterating through an array using two pointer positions moving inward or outward.

name: Sliding Window
description: Dynamic or fixed-size contiguous subarray window processing.

name: String Traversal
description: Character indexing, ASCII/Unicode character properties, and string immutability.

name: Frequency Counting
description: Counting character frequencies using fixed-size arrays or hash maps.

name: String Matching Basics
description: Pattern search, substring checks, and sliding window string comparisons.

name: Linked List Traversal
description: Pointer traversal through singly or doubly linked list node chains.

name: Linked List Insertion
description: Inserting nodes at head, tail, or given positions while preserving pointer links.

name: Linked List Deletion
description: Deleting nodes, updating next pointers, and handling null references.

name: Fast and Slow Pointers
description: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm using dual-speed pointer traversal.

name: Cycle Detection
description: Detecting loop structures in linked lists and finding cycle entry nodes.

name: Stack Operations
description: LIFO push, pop, peek operations and stack overflow/underflow handling.

name: Balanced Parentheses
description: Matching nested delimiters using LIFO stack state.

name: Monotonic Stack
description: Maintaining monotonically increasing/decreasing stack elements for next greater element problems.

name: Queue Operations
description: FIFO enqueue, dequeue, front, and rear operations.

name: Deque
description: Double-ended queue operations enabling insertion/deletion at both ends in O(1).

name: Base Case
description: Identifying and handling call termination conditions to prevent stack overflow.

name: Recursive State
description: Passing state arguments through call stacks and subproblem decomposition.

name: Backtracking
description: Systematic search space exploration with state modification and undoing choices.

name: Hash Map
description: Key-value pair storage providing average O(1) lookups and insertions.

name: Hash Set
description: Unique element collections for O(1) membership testing.

name: Frequency Map
description: Mapping elements to occurrences for anagrams, duplicates, and top-K elements.

name: Binary Tree
description: Hierarchical node structure where each node has at most two children.

name: Tree DFS
description: Pre-order, In-order, and Post-order depth-first recursive tree traversals.

name: Tree BFS
description: Level-order traversal using a queue to visit tree nodes level by level.

name: Tree Traversal
description: Reconstructing trees or computing tree metrics (height, diameter, path sum).

name: Binary Search Tree
description: Binary tree property where left < node < right for all nodes.

name: Min Heap
description: Complete binary tree property where parent <= children, root is minimum.

name: Max Heap
description: Complete binary tree property where parent >= children, root is maximum.

name: Priority Queue
description: Abstract data type supporting O(log N) insert and O(1) peek/extract optimal element.

name: Graph Representation
description: Adjacency matrix vs Adjacency list representation of directed/undirected graphs.

name: Graph BFS
description: Breadth-first graph search exploring layer-by-layer using queue and visited set.

name: Graph DFS
description: Depth-first graph search exploring branch pathways recursively with backtracking.

name: Connected Components
description: Counting and isolating disjoint connected subgraphs using BFS/DFS or Disjoint Set Union.

name: Shortest Path Basics
description: Unweighted shortest path via BFS and Dijkstra's algorithm for non-negative weighted graphs.

name: Greedy Choice Property
description: Making locally optimal choices at each step to reach a global optimum.

name: Interval Scheduling
description: Sorting intervals by end time to maximize non-overlapping interval selection.

name: DP State Definition
description: Formulating subproblem state representation parameters.

name: DP State Transition
description: Establishing mathematical recurrence relations connecting subproblems.

name: Memoization
description: Top-down recursive DP storing intermediate subproblem outcomes in a cache.

name: Tabulation
description: Bottom-up iterative DP populating DP table from base cases up to target N.

name: 1D DP
description: Solving single-variable state DP problems (e.g. Climbing Stairs, House Robber, Coin Change).

name: Memory Model
description: Understanding stack vs heap memory, allocation lifetimes, and memory addresses.

name: Pointer Basics
description: Understanding memory addresses, pointer variables, and referencing operators.

name: Pointer Dereferencing
description: Accessing values at pointed memory addresses, pointer arithmetic, and null pointer guards.
